import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
base="450d987e22164364e08e5ea0eadaaeaf2dcef096"
prefix="udt_gr_filter_reconciliation_2026-09-09"
six={"LIVE.md","HANDOFF.md","CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md","CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.md","MEMORY.md","INDEX.md"}
git=["git","-c","core.preloadIndex=false","-c","index.threads=1","-c","core.packedGitWindowSize=16m","-c","core.packedGitLimit=64m"]
def get(*args):
 return subprocess.check_output(git+list(args))
def sha(data):
 return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
manifest=root/prefix/"EVIDENCE_SHA256SUMS"
assert sha(manifest.read_bytes())=="1ce016590c72fa158603479e50798392026f804d665791e38dae48c7c8ed1999"
pins=[]
for line in manifest.read_text().splitlines():
 expected,path=line.split(maxsplit=1)
 data=get("show",base+":"+path) if path in six else (root/path).read_bytes()
 assert sha(data)==expected,path
 pins.append({"path":path,"validated_at":base if path in six else "actual_current_bytes","sha256":expected})
assert len(pins)==120
changed=get("diff","--name-only",base,"--").decode().splitlines()
assert all(p in six or p.startswith(prefix+"/documentation_closeout/") for p in changed),changed
for p in ["CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv","verify_current_scientific_premises.py","tests/test_startup_surface.py","CANON.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_DEVELOPMENT.md","UDT_METRIC_KERNEL_COVERAGE.tsv","AGENTS.md","CLAUDE.md"]:
 assert (root/p).read_bytes()==get("show",base+":"+p),p
old_package=get("ls-tree","-r","--name-only",base,"--",prefix).decode().splitlines()
actual=get("hash-object","--",*old_package).decode().splitlines()
tree=get("ls-tree","-r",base,"--",prefix).decode().splitlines()
assert [line.split()[2] for line in tree]==actual
untracked=sorted(line for line in get("status","--short","--untracked-files=normal").decode().splitlines() if line.startswith("?? ") and not line[3:].startswith(prefix+"/documentation_closeout/"))
assert len(untracked)==46 and sha("\n".join(untracked).encode())=="d65d71d63a56b95aabfd61f33317b1f1f2b2a62a85ded8258c525b99a5e156ea"
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS_DOCUMENTARY_PRESERVATION_NOT_FULL365","baseline":base,"manifest_pins":pins,"manifest_count":len(pins),"old_package_files_byte_unchanged":len(old_package),"allowed_current_paths":changed,"unrelated_untracked_names":46,"protected_payloads":"NOT_INSPECTED","scope":"No new proof, premise, registry, verifier/test, canon, manuscript or original evidence change; old current-page pins remain historical."},indent=2))
